document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function() {
    // Countdown timer
    var countDown = document.getElementsByClassName("jsCountdown")[0];
    var endDate = new Date(1000 * countDown.dataset.enddate);
    var progressBar = document.getElementsByClassName("vfProgressBar")[0];

    var intervalId = setInterval(function(){
        var currentDate = new Date();
        var timeLeft = endDate - currentDate - 72e5;
        var days = Math.floor(timeLeft / 864e5);
        var hours = Math.floor(timeLeft % 864e5 / 36e5);
        var minutes = Math.floor(timeLeft % 36e5 / 6e4);
        var seconds = Math.floor(timeLeft % 6e4 / 1000);
        var timeLeftString = "";
        
        if(days > 1) {
            timeLeftString += days + " jours ";
        } else if(days === 1) {
            timeLeftString += days + " jour ";
        }
        if(hours > 0) {
            timeLeftString += hours + " h ";
        }
        if(minutes > 0) {
            timeLeftString += minutes + " min et ";
        }
        timeLeftString += seconds + "s";
        countDown.innerHTML = timeLeftString;
        if(timeLeft < 0) {
            clearInterval(intervalId);
            countDown.innerHTML = countDown.dataset.endtxt;
        }
    }, 1000);

    var progress = 100 * (endDate - new Date - 72e5) / 864e5;
    progressBar.style.width = progress + "%";
});

document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
    // Gestion des cartes de produits épuisés
    const cardElements = document.querySelectorAll('.c-productCard--soldout');
    cardElements.forEach(function(cardElement) {
        cardElement.addEventListener('mouseover', function() {
            this.classList.remove('c-productCard--soldout');
        });
        cardElement.addEventListener('mouseout', function() {
            this.classList.add('c-productCard--soldout');
        });
    });
    
    
    
    // Gestion des onglets et changement de couleur
    const onTabPanelClick = (control) => {
        const container = control.closest(".js-tabs");
        const tabPanels = [...container.querySelectorAll(".js-tabs__panel")];
        const tabControls = [...container.querySelectorAll(".js-tabs__controls .c-tabs__control")];
        
        
        
        const clickedTabIndex = tabControls.indexOf(control);
        tabPanels.forEach((panel, index) => {
            if (index === clickedTabIndex) {
                panel.classList.add("is-active");
                panel.classList.remove("is-hidden");
                
                
                
            } else {
                panel.classList.remove("is-active");
                panel.classList.add("is-hidden");
            }
        });
        
        
        
        tabControls.forEach((control, index) => {
            if (index === clickedTabIndex) {
                control.setAttribute("aria-selected", "true");
                control.tabIndex = 0;
            } else {
                control.setAttribute("aria-selected", "false");
                control.tabIndex = -1;
            }
        });
        
        
        
        const elementsToColor = [
            document.querySelector('.l-promo__content'),
            document.querySelector('.l-promo__section--hero')
        ];
        
        const panelId = control.getAttribute('href');
        
        const classesToRemove = ['l-promo__content--panel1', 'l-promo__content--panel2', 'l-promo__content--panel3', 'l-promo__content--panel4'];
        
        
        
        elementsToColor.forEach(element => {
            classesToRemove.forEach(className => {
                element.classList.remove(className);
            });
            
            switch(panelId) {
                case '#tab1Panel1':
                element.classList.add('l-promo__content--panel1');
                break;
                case '#tab1Panel2':
                element.classList.add('l-promo__content--panel2');
                break;
                case '#tab1Panel3':
                element.classList.add('l-promo__content--panel3');
                break;
                case '#tab1Panel4':
                element.classList.add('l-promo__content--panel4');
                break;
                default:
                break;
            }
        });
        
        
        
        return false;
    };
    
    
    
    const tabControls = document.querySelectorAll(".js-tabs__controls .c-tabs__control");
    tabControls.forEach(control => {
        control.addEventListener('click', function(event) {
            event.preventDefault();
            onTabPanelClick(this);
        });
    });
});

window.onClickLoadMore = (loadMoreBtn, container, itemsShowOnClick = 4) => {
    const hideItems = document.querySelectorAll(`${container} .u-hide, ${container} .hidden-on-pc`);
    hideItems.forEach((item, index) => {
        if (index < itemsShowOnClick) item.classList.remove("u-hide", "hidden-on-pc");
    });
    
    if (hideItems?.length <= itemsShowOnClick) {
        loadMoreBtn.style.display = "none";
    } else {
        loadMoreBtn.style.display = "inline-flex";
    }
};

document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function(){
    const tab1Panel1 = document.getElementById("tab1Panel1");
    const tab1Panel2 = document.getElementById("tab1Panel2");
    
    const tab1Control = document.querySelector(".c-tabs__control[href='#tab1Panel1']");
    const tab2Control = document.querySelector(".c-tabs__control[href='#tab1Panel2']");
    
    tab1Control.addEventListener("click", function(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        tab1Panel1.style.display = "block";
        tab1Panel2.style.display = "none";
    });
    
    tab2Control.addEventListener("click", function(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        tab1Panel1.style.display = "none";
        tab1Panel2.style.display = "block";
    });
    
    const tabButtons = document.querySelectorAll('.c-tabs__control');
    tabButtons.forEach(button => {
        button.addEventListener('click', e => {
            e.preventDefault();
            const panelId = button.getAttribute('href');
            const activePanel = document.querySelector('.js-tabs__panel.is-active');
            const targetPanel = document.querySelector(panelId);
            if (!targetPanel.classList.contains('is-active')) {
                activePanel.classList.remove('is-active');
                targetPanel.classList.add('is-active');
            }
        });
    });
    
});

// affiche une image alternative au survol
$(function() {
    $(".js-card").each(function () {
        let $img = $(this).find("img:first");
        if ($img.data("hover")) {
            $(this).mouseenter(function() {
                $img.attr("src", $img.data("hover"));
            })
            .mouseleave(function() {
                $img.attr("src", $img.data("start"));
            });
        }
    });
});

    function copyCodeToClipboard(code) {
        const el = document.createElement('textarea');
        el.value = code;
        document.body.appendChild(el);
        el.select();
        document.execCommand('copy');
        document.body.removeChild(el);

        // Modifier le texte après la copie
        const codeElements = document.getElementsByClassName('code');
        for (let i = 0; i < codeElements.length; i++) {
            const codeElement = codeElements[i];
            if (codeElement.innerText === code) {
                codeElement.innerText = 'copié !';
                break;
            }
        }
    }

  document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", () => {
    const carousel = document.getElementById("carousel");
    const indicatorsContainer = document.getElementById("carousel-indicators");
    let carouselItems = carousel.querySelectorAll("#carousel a");
    const prevButton = document.getElementById("prev");
    const nextButton = document.getElementById("next");
    const indicators = indicatorsContainer.children;
    let currentIndex = 1;

    const firstClone = carouselItems[0].cloneNode(true);
    carousel.appendChild(firstClone);
    const lastClone = carouselItems[carouselItems.length - 1].cloneNode(true);
    carousel.insertBefore(lastClone, carouselItems[0]);

    carouselItems = carousel.querySelectorAll("#carousel a");
    const firstRealItem = carouselItems[1];
    const lastRealItem = carouselItems[carouselItems.length - 2];

    for (let i = 0; i < carouselItems.length - 2; i++) {
      const button = document.createElement("button");
      button.setAttribute("data-index", i);
      if (i === 0) button.classList.add("active");
      indicatorsContainer.appendChild(button);
    }

    function moveToIndex() {
      if (currentIndex < 0) {
        currentIndex = 0;
      }
      if (currentIndex >= carouselItems.length) {
        currentIndex = carouselItems.length - 1;
      }
      carousel.scrollTo({
        left: carouselItems[currentIndex].offsetLeft,
        behavior: "smooth",
      });
    }
    prevButton.addEventListener("click", () => {
      currentIndex -= 1;
      moveToIndex();
    });

    nextButton.addEventListener("click", () => {
      currentIndex += 1;
      moveToIndex();
    });

    carousel.addEventListener("scroll", () => {
      const scrollLeft = carousel.scrollLeft;
      const scrollWidth = carousel.scrollWidth - carousel.clientWidth;
      const index = Math.round(
        (scrollLeft / scrollWidth - 1 / carouselItems.length) *
          (carouselItems.length - 1)
      );

      for (let i = 0; i < indicators.length; i++) {
        indicators[i].classList.remove("active");
      }
      if (index >= indicators.length) {
        indicators[indicators.length - 1].classList.add("active");
      } else if (index < 0) {
        indicators[0].classList.add("active");
      } else {
        indicators[index].classList.add("active");
      }

      let animation = null;
      if (scrollLeft + carousel.clientWidth >= carousel.scrollWidth - 10) {
        clearTimeout(animation);
        animation = setTimeout(() => {
          currentIndex = 1;
          carousel.scrollTo({
            left: firstRealItem.offsetLeft,
            behavior: "auto",
          });
        }, 150);
      } else if (scrollLeft <= 10) {
        clearTimeout(animation);
        animation = setTimeout(() => {
          currentIndex = carouselItems.length - 2;
          carousel.scrollTo({
            left: lastRealItem.offsetLeft,
            behavior: "auto",
          });
        }, 150);
      }
    });

    for (let i = 0; i < indicators.length; i++) {
      indicators[i].addEventListener("click", () => {
        const index = indicators[i].getAttribute("data-index");
        carousel.scrollTo({
          left: carouselItems[parseInt(index) + 1].offsetLeft,
          behavior: "smooth",
        });
      });
    }

    function scrollToFirstThreshold() {
      if (firstRealItem.offsetHeight > 0) {
        carousel.scrollTo({
          left: firstRealItem.offsetLeft,
          behavior: "auto",
        });
      } else {
        setTimeout(scrollToFirstThreshold, 10);
      }
    }
    setTimeout(scrollToFirstThreshold, 10);
  });
